title: jsdom 30.1.3 bump in console-ui test toolchain
summary: A dependency-only change: the console-ui package moves its jsdom devDependency from 30.0.1 to 30.1.3, and the lockfile re-resolves jsdom's transitive tree accordingly. The visible effects are a newer DOM-selector/CSS parsing stack (@asamuzakjp/dom-selector 8→10, @asamuzakjp/css-color 6→7, @csstools tokenizer/parser 4.0.0→4.0.2), newer URL/encoding helpers (whatwg-url 17.3.0, data-urls 8, tr46 7, html-encoding-sniffer 7, w3c-xmlserializer 6), undici 8.12.3, and the removal of symbol-tree. No application source changes; only the test runtime that renders console-ui components under Vitest is affected.

lanes.label: console-ui package
lanes.subtitle: React console, tested under jsdom
lanes.summary: The package whose devDependency moved. Its source is untouched; only the test environment it runs in changes.

lanes.label: Test runtime
lanes.subtitle: Vitest + jsdom DOM emulation
lanes.summary: The DOM implementation the console-ui tests execute against. jsdom 30.1.3 replaces 30.0.1 here.

lanes.label: jsdom dependency tree
lanes.subtitle: Resolved by pnpm-lock.yaml
lanes.summary: The transitive packages jsdom pulls in. Most of the diff lives here: selector, CSS parsing, URL and encoding helpers all move forward a major or minor.

lanes.label: Build & test toolchain
lanes.subtitle: pnpm workspace
lanes.summary: The workspace resolver and the rest of the monorepo's tooling. Unchanged, but it is what turns the package.json edit into a new lockfile resolution.

nodes.label: @software-factory/console-ui
nodes.subtitle: devDependencies: jsdom 30.0.1 → 30.1.3
nodes.summary: The console UI package. The only edit in its manifest is the jsdom devDependency version; runtime dependencies and source are untouched.

nodes.label: console-ui test suite
nodes.subtitle: @testing-library/react + user-event
nodes.summary: Component tests that render into a jsdom document. They are the consumer of the bumped dependency and the reason it exists in the tree at all.

nodes.label: jsdom
nodes.summary: The DOM emulation layer. The bump pulls a new major of the DOM selector and CSS color stack, drops symbol-tree, and raises the minimum Node engine to ^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0.

nodes.label: @asamuzakjp/dom-selector
nodes.summary: Selector matching engine used by jsdom's querySelector paths. A two-major jump, and the largest single version move in the diff.

nodes.label: @asamuzakjp/css-color
nodes.summary: CSS color resolution for computed styles. Moves a major and drags the @csstools parser/tokenizer family with it.

nodes.label: @csstools css parser family
nodes.subtitle: tokenizer 4.0.1 → 4.0.2, calc/color-parser bumped
nodes.summary: The CSS tokenizer, parser-algorithms, calc and color-parser packages. All move in lockstep because their peer ranges are pinned to each other.

nodes.label: whatwg-url
nodes.summary: URL implementation behind jsdom's location and anchor handling. The older 16.0.1 copy that data-urls used is gone; everything now resolves to 17.3.0.

nodes.label: data-urls
nodes.summary: Data URL parsing. The major bump is what collapses the duplicate whatwg-url 16.x copy out of the tree.

nodes.label: tr46
nodes.summary: IDNA/punycode conversion used by whatwg-url. Major bump, and it raises its own Node engine floor.

nodes.label: html-encoding-sniffer / w3c-xmlserializer
nodes.subtitle: 6.0.0 → 7.0.0 and 5.0.0 → 6.0.0
nodes.summary: Character-encoding detection and XML serialization. Both take a major bump alongside the URL stack.

nodes.label: undici
nodes.summary: Fetch/HTTP implementation jsdom uses for resource loading. A minor bump within 8.x.

nodes.label: symbol-tree
nodes.subtitle: 3.2.4, dropped
nodes.summary: Previously a direct jsdom dependency; jsdom 30.1.3 no longer needs it, so the package and its snapshot entry leave the lockfile.

nodes.label: pnpm workspace resolver
nodes.subtitle: pnpm-lock.yaml
nodes.summary: Resolves the manifest edit into the concrete dependency graph. Every version change in this diff is its output.

nodes.label: Vitest
nodes.subtitle: test runner
nodes.summary: Runs the console-ui suite with jsdom as the environment. Unchanged, but it is the boundary through which the new jsdom reaches the tests.

edges.label: devDependency 30.1.3
edges.summary: The one line the change is about: the manifest now asks for jsdom 30.1.3 instead of 30.0.1.
The test suite renders components into jsdom's document; this is why the bump reaches anything at all.
Vitest executes the suite with jsdom configured as the environment.
The workspace reads the manifest and writes the resolved versions into the lockfile.
jsdom 30.1.3 requires the 10.x selector engine, a two-major move from the 8.x it used before.
Computed-style color resolution moves a major.
The color parser is built on the @csstools tokenizer and parser-algorithms packages, which move with it.
URL handling moves a minor, and the duplicate 16.x copy disappears from the tree.
data-urls 8 now resolves to the same whatwg-url 17.3.0 as jsdom, collapsing the duplicate.
IDNA conversion moves a major underneath the URL stack.
Encoding sniffing and XML serialization both take a major bump.
Resource loading moves a minor within undici 8.x.

edges.label: no longer required
edges.summary: jsdom 30.1.3 no longer depends on symbol-tree, so it leaves the lockfile entirely.

views.title: console-ui test stack
views.summary: How the jsdom bump reaches the console-ui tests: manifest → jsdom → its transitive tree, with the workspace resolver and Vitest as the unchanged context.
